text:
Situation: Potassium acetate is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current stock across three sites provides 12.7 to 22.8 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2019-06-10, since resolved. Earlier inspections at the same plant were classified VAI, including inspection 1006274 ending 2017-03-17 (815 days before posting), inspection 1039547 ending 2018-02-02 (493 days before posting), and inspection 1066469 ending 2018-09-21 (262 days before posting). The current label names Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1021343) and Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) as registered plants.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. No active shortage exists per FDA. We should secure a secondary source to reduce reliance on a single supply chain.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC (not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant). Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to initiate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (not on FDA shortage list; label names no identifiable plant). Requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or clinical protocol changes at this time.
